name: less
summary: Shows a file page by page, with scrolling and search.
description: Opens a file (or the output of a pipe) in a full-screen pager, without loading it entirely: ideal for large files. Keys: Space / b to go forward / back one page, arrows for one line, g and G for the start and end, /pattern to search (n and N for the next and previous match), F to follow the file like tail -f, q to quit. It is the pager man uses.

options.description: Does not wrap long lines: scroll sideways with the arrows (handy for CSV files).
Case-insensitive search, unless the pattern contains an uppercase letter.
Shows colors (ANSI codes) properly, for example those of grep --color=always.
Quits immediately if the contents fit on one screen.
Leaves the contents displayed in the terminal after quitting.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: File(s) to read. Without a file: standard input (end of a pipe).

examples.explanation: Browses the system log; /error then n to find each error.
Reads a script with line numbers.
Reads a wide CSV without wrapping lines.
Browses grep’s results while keeping their colors.
